{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -N BUSCO
#   -P xl04
#   -q normalsr
#   -l walltime=20:00:00
#   -l mem=512GB
#   -l ncpus=104
#   -j oe
#   -l storage=gdata/xl04+gdata/if89
#   -l wd
#   -l jobfs=100GB
#   -M kirat.alreja@anu.edu.au

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  -c 104 \
  --time=20h \
  --queue=normalsr \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: PBS -P xl04 (project/allocation) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: PBS mem=512GB has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: without a memory request/limit, the job may be placed where less memory is available,
# increasing risk of OOM or contention.

# NOTE: PBS storage=gdata/xl04+gdata/if89 has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: none directly for performance, but the job may fail to access required filesystems or quotas.

# NOTE: PBS jobfs=100GB (local job filesystem/scratch) has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: you may not get fast local scratch; I/O may be slower if it falls back to network filesystems.

# NOTE: PBS -l wd (run in submission directory) cannot be replicated portably; this script uses cd ${outpath} instead.

# NOTE: PBS email (-M ...) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive job emails.

# NOTE: PBS job name (-N BUSCO) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

# PBS -j oe (join stdout/stderr): approximate by redirecting stderr to stdout.
exec 2>&1

module load singularity

# inputs: fasta, outpath (expected to be set in the environment)
lineage=/g/data/xl04/bpadata/Bassiana_duperreyi/projects/chromsyn/busco_downloads
prefix=$(basename "${fasta}" .fasta)
cd "${outpath}"

# PBS used ${PBS_NCPUS}; approximate with allocated core count (104).
singularity exec /g/data/xl04/ka6418/docker_images/busco-5.4.7.sif \
  busco -o run_${prefix} --offline -i "$fasta" -l sauropsida_odb10 \
  --download_path "$lineage" --cpu 104 -m genome --tar
'
"
}
